plugins.name: kubernetes-operator
plugins.description: Expert Kubernetes assistant — kubectl, manifests, Helm, GitOps (Flux/Argo CD), security hardening, debugging playbooks, and cluster operations

plugins.name: kagent
plugins.description: Expert guide for kagent — the Kubernetes-native framework for running AI agents: CLI, Agent/ModelConfig/RemoteMCPServer CRDs, MCP tools, A2A subagents, human-in-the-loop approval, memory, IDE integration, and troubleshooting

plugins.name: kgateway
plugins.description: Expert guide for kgateway — the CNCF Kubernetes Gateway API implementation powered by Envoy (formerly Gloo): installation, Gateway/HTTPRoute setup, traffic management, security (TLS, JWT, ext-auth, rate limiting), resiliency, Istio integration, observability, and debugging

plugins.name: agentgateway
plugins.description: Expert guide for agentgateway — the Linux Foundation AI-native proxy data plane (Rust, used by kgateway): MCP tool federation, A2A agent-to-agent proxying, multi-provider LLM/AI gateway routing, general traffic management, security, and observability, for both standalone and Kubernetes Gateway API deployments

plugins.name: fluxcd
plugins.description: Expert guide for Flux CD GitOps on Kubernetes — install/bootstrap, repository structure, Flux resources, SOPS/RBAC security, validation, operations, upgrades, and troubleshooting

plugins.name: argocd
plugins.description: Expert guide for Argo CD GitOps on Kubernetes — install/upgrade, Application/AppProject/ApplicationSet resources, Helm/Kustomize workflows, RBAC/SSO security, operations, HA, and troubleshooting

plugins.name: bash-scripting
plugins.description: Expert guide for writing, hardening, debugging, and reviewing Bash and POSIX shell scripts — strict mode, defensive patterns, safe quoting/expansion, arrays, trap-based cleanup, getopts parsing, ShellCheck/shfmt linting, Bats testing, and Linux/macOS portability

plugins.name: helm
plugins.description: Expert guide for Helm — authoring charts, Go/Sprig templating, the helm CLI and release lifecycle (install/upgrade/rollback), discovering existing charts and repositories, and debugging chart-rendering and release failures with lint, template, dry-run, and manifest inspection

plugins.name: karpenter
plugins.description: Karpenter node autoscaling expert for EKS — NodePools, EC2NodeClasses, EKS Auto Mode NodeClasses, consolidation/disruption tuning, spot adoption, GPU pools, cost optimization, and node-level troubleshooting

plugins.name: prompt-enhancer
plugins.description: Improve and enhance prompts — turn a raw, vague, or first-draft prompt into a clearer, stronger instruction by applying an ordered set of prompt-engineering techniques (clarity, context, multishot examples, XML structure, role, chain-of-thought, prompt chaining) and returning the rewrite plus a tagged change log

plugins.name: sre-agent
plugins.description: Agentic SRE orchestrator — evidence-first incident investigation across Kubernetes, Prometheus metrics, Loki or Elasticsearch/OpenSearch logs, Tempo/Jaeger traces, service-mesh state, and recent changes; ranked root-cause hypotheses; approval-gated remediation with rollback plans; validation — optionally under k6 load — and final incident reports

plugins.name: opsman
plugins.description: Local-first meta-agent orchestrator for Dev and Ops tasks — discovers repository-local skills, selects the smallest team, runs a test-first evidence-gated loop with deterministic POSIX state, and gates completion behind an independent Oracle

plugins.name: gcloud
plugins.description: Expert guide for the Google Cloud CLI — install/init/components, authentication (gcloud auth login vs Application Default Credentials, service accounts, impersonation, workload identity federation), named configurations and properties, scripting with --format/--filter projections, proxy settings, and headless/CI usage

plugins.name: gh-guru
plugins.description: Expert GitHub guide — gh CLI mastery (repo/pr/issue/run/release/api with --json/--jq), authoring GitHub Actions workflows, building custom actions (composite, TypeScript/JavaScript, Docker), CI/CD best practices, Actions security hardening (SHA pinning, least-privilege permissions, OIDC), and repository management (rulesets, CODEOWNERS, releases, GHCR)

plugins.name: glab-guru
plugins.description: Expert GitLab guide — glab CLI mastery (mr/issue/ci/job/release/api with -F json/--jq), authoring .gitlab-ci.yml (rules, workflow, needs, artifacts, cache, includes, spec inputs), designing CI/CD pipelines (DAG, parent-child, multi-project, merge trains, environments), CI/CD components and the catalog, and pipeline security hardening (OIDC id_tokens, CI_JOB_TOKEN allowlists, protected branches/environments, masked variables)

plugins.name: aws
plugins.description: Expert AWS CLI guide — install/update/pin AWS CLI v2 and migrate off v1, authentication (IAM Identity Center SSO, short-term credentials, assume-role, credential precedence), profiles and config files, scripting with --query JMESPath, output formats, pagination, and return codes
